decisions.question: Is the jacket’s front closure fully closed in the edited image, rather than still open as in the source?
decisions.criteria: Pass if the edited jacket’s front panels meet along the closure with no visible opening remaining; fail if any opening remains or the closure is no more closed than in the source; unknown only if the closure cannot be observed.
decisions.binding: The requested endpoint is a fully closed jacket, not merely progress toward closing it.
decisions.endpoint: The jacket’s front panels are brought together with no visible opening remaining along the closure.
decisions.necessity: The instruction explicitly requires the jacket to be closed fully. A remaining visible opening means the requested endpoint is incomplete; this is the distinct requested visual change.
